claim: India's Vitamin D supplements market was valued at USD 66.8 Million in 2025 and is projected to reach USD 126.2 Million by 2034, growing at a CAGR of 7.12% during 2026-2034.

scope_conditions: India; Vitamin D supplements market (D2 and D3 combined); 2025 base year
quoted_support: The India vitamin D supplements market size reached USD 66.8 Million in 2025. Looking forward, IMARC Group expects the market to reach USD 126.2 Million by 2034, exhibiting a growth rate (CAGR) of 7.12% during 2026-2034.

claim: Online retailing is one of the key distribution channels driving India's Vitamin D supplement market growth, alongside pharmacies/health stores and supermarkets/hypermarkets.

claim: Abbott India's Vitamin D portfolio (including Arachitol Gummies) contributed to 11.8% revenue growth in FY2023-24, demonstrating commercial viability of Vitamin D supplements in India.
stance_target: Commercial success and growth potential of Vitamin D supplement brands in India
scope_conditions: India; established pharmaceutical supplement brands; FY2023-24
quoted_support: Abbott India seeks to consolidate its range of multi-specialty supplements like vitamin D and thyroid health-related products by increasing new product introductions and growing awareness.
